title: Tim Cone explains why Justin Brownlee did not play at Asian Games
summary: Gilas Pilipinas head coach Tim Cone gave an update on the status of Justin Brownlee, after he was unable to suit up for the national team at the Asian Games and has yet to return for Barangay Ginebra.
